# Mitrangan De-Addiction & Rehabilitation Kendra, Nagpur

> Mitrangan is a premier, voluntary residential de-addiction and psychiatric rehabilitation facility based in Godhani, Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. Mitrangan provides structured substance abuse treatment, medically monitored detoxification support, behavioral counseling, and 24/7 discrete patient pickup across Central India and Vidarbha.

## Facility Overview
- **Name**: Mitrangan De-Addiction Cum Rehabilitation Center
- **Location**: Plot No. 7, Manasvi Multi-speciality Hospital, Khangar Layout, Opp. Satyam Garden, Godhani, Nagpur – 441123, Maharashtra, India
- **Helpline (24/7)**: +91 9767362388
- **Emergency WhatsApp**: +91 9767362388
- **Primary Website**: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com

## Core Clinical & Rehabilitation Services
- **Alcohol De-Addiction & Medical Detoxification**: Comprehensive alcohol dependency treatment featuring delirium tremens monitoring, physiological stabilization, vitamin therapy, and relapse prevention counseling.
  URL: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/alcohol-deaddiction
- **Substance & Drug Rehabilitation**: Specialized programs for brown sugar, heroin, cannabis/ganja, prescription opioids, MDMA, and multi-substance dependencies with individualized cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT).
  URL: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/drug-rehabilitation
- **Clinical Detoxification Support**: 24-hour round-the-clock medical supervision during initial acute withdrawal phases ensuring resident comfort, dignity, and safety.
  URL: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/services/detoxification-support
- **Admission Process & Step-by-Step Guidance**: Transparent intake protocols, essential document checklists, family orientation, and immediate intake coordination.
  URL: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/admission-process
- **Confidential Addiction Screener (Self-Assessment)**: Free, clinical-grade assessment based on DSM-5 criteria to help individuals and families evaluate addiction severity.
  URL: https://nagpurnashamuktikendra.com/self-assessment

## Geographic Areas Served
Nagpur, Godhani, Koradi, Mankapur, Sadar, Dharampeth, Sitabuldi, Hingna, Wadi, Kamptee, Wardha, Amravati, Chandrapur, Bhandara, Gondia, Yavatmal, Chhindwara, and throughout the Vidarbha region.
